title: Tom and His Sports
text:
Tom likes football. He plays football on Saturday with his friends. They play in the park. Tom is a good player.

Tom also likes swimming. He swims in the pool on Monday and Wednesday. After swimming, he is very hungry. He eats an apple.

questions.text: What sport does Tom play with his friends?
On which days does Tom swim?
Why is Tom hungry after swimming?
options: He uses a lot of energy
He stayed in the pool all day

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel about sport?

a place with water where people swim

paragraph_translations: Том любить футбол. Він грає у футбол у суботу зі своїми друзями. Вони грають у парку. Том — добрий гравець.
Том також любить плавання. Він плаває в басейні в понеділок і середу. Після плавання він дуже голодний. Він їсть яблуко.
